notes.title: Trail of Angels VR — Major Visual Update Now Live!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513771/320213c8c9ba0714b6025f8fe97844a8ced2d8a3.png"][/img][/p][p]Step deeper into the mysterious afterlife…[/p][p]We’ve just released a powerful new update for Trail of Angels VR, bringing you an even more immersive and breathtaking experience:[/p][p]* Sharper Resolution – See the spirit realm like never before, with enhanced visual clarity that brings every ethereal detail to life.[/p][p]* Vibrant Color Enhancements – The palette of the afterlife has been reborn. Richer tones and deeper contrasts breathe new life into every scene.[/p][p]* Improved Object Dynamics – Some of the otherworldly elements now move and react with greater realism, pulling you further into the dreamlike journey.[/p][p][/p][p]Whether you're returning or visiting for the first time…[/p][p]Don't be afraid to wander.[/p][p]The afterlife has secrets waiting to be uncovered.[/p][p][/p][p]Update your experience now on Steam and step beyond the veil.[/p]
